plan: Reduce broad index exposure (SPY) to 20% to lower concentration.

conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration risk, holding a larger cash buffer for stability. Drawdowns are expected to be minimal.

plan: Trim broad index (SPY) to 25% to address concentration.

balanced.read: This balanced approach aims for risk-first growth with a target of ~2.5% monthly return. It blends broad market exposure with quality tech and reduced leverage. A moderate cash buffer is maintained, balancing growth potential with controlled risk.

plan: Trim broad index (SPY) to 25% to allow for concentration.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentration. It increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-conviction names, accepting higher potential upside and significantly larger drawdowns. Daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs can impact returns.

plan: Reduce broad index (SPY) to 20% to prioritize income.
Exit all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and high-beta tech (CRWD).

income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly return through distributions, prioritizing low drawdown. It shifts away from growth and leverage towards income-generating assets. While aiming for stability, NAV can still decline in market downturns.
